title: Add expense interim approval controls, approval outcomes, and approver lookup
summary: Expense Agent now supports interim approval controls with explicit approval outcomes, an interim approver capability flag, and an API to discover available approvers for assignment.
key_points: Added SubmitAndAssignInterimApprover action to release, assign, and submit expense reports in one transaction
New approval outcome endpoints return approval status, completion state, and next approver information as JSON
InterimApprover capability reflects Allow Interim Approvers setting; ApprovalsWithOutcome capability always enabled
New availableApprovers API collection and per-user endpoint expose eligible approvers for interim assignment
Interim assignments clear on resubmission when feature is disabled; active approvals are preserved
quote: This PR adds interim approval controls and explicit approval outcomes.
